problem_statement: The MQTT-SN client fails to reject messages whose source address is longer than the maximum address size it can store. When an incoming message carries a source address whose size exceeds CONFIG_MQTT_SN_LIB_MAX_ADDR_SIZE, the client should reject the message and return -ENOBUFS instead of processing it, because the address cannot be copied into its internal buffer and doing so would read out of bounds. Currently such a message is accepted and processed as if it were valid.

verification.reason: The problem statement clearly specifies the required behavior: when a source address size exceeds CONFIG_MQTT_SN_LIB_MAX_ADDR_SIZE, the client must return -ENOBUFS instead of processing the message. The hidden test directly verifies this by passing an address of size CONFIG_MQTT_SN_LIB_MAX_ADDR_SIZE + 1 and asserting -ENOBUFS. All names used in the test (CONFIG_MQTT_SN_LIB_MAX_ADDR_SIZE, struct mqtt_sn_data, -ENOBUFS) are either mentioned in the statement or are existing repository symbols the agent can discover. The NUM_TEST_CLIENTS increment is test infrastructure applied by the hidden test itself.
